title: A general counting and sampling Lovász local lemma
summary: Consider a constraint satisfaction problem $\mathbf{C}$ on finitely many independent random variables with dependency graph $G$. Let $p_a$ be the violation probability of a constraint $a\in \mathbf{C}$ and $N_G^2 (a)$ the set of constraints at distance one or two from $a$ in $G$.
